title: Cooling down, starting again

data.source: Two toy problems (a noisy bowl and a bumpy field), 200 seeded runs per schedule, 3000 steps each.

prediction: The cosine schedule with warm restarts is a half-turn, a cut and a carried seed by construction. CRR's grammar makes no prediction about whether restarting helps, so there is nothing that could pass or fail; the toy results are recorded for information.
baseline: A single cosine decay over the same number of steps, and a constant step size.
why: The mapping is exact, but only as a description: the method was built from a half-cosine and a reset. Whether restarts help is the question that matters, and R1 to R6 are silent on it.
